notes: The datasheet gives two different answers — a spec-table figure and conditional body guidance. A complete answer carries both and says which condition applies.

turns.content: What's the calibration interval for the pH probe?

must_contain: gives the datasheet spec of ~1 year time before recalibration
gives the body guidance: no set schedule — in weak acid/base environments once per year for the first two years, then roughly every six months
notes monthly or per-batch calibration applies to strong-acid/base or industrial process use
must_not: states our deployment needs monthly calibration

turns.content: Which of those applies to us?

must_contain: maps a natural water deployment to the weak-chemistry case: yearly for the first two years, then roughly every six months
notes fouling or a failed calibration check can force it sooner
must_not: applies the industrial-process interval to this deployment
